title: rosa × harisonii var. vorbergii
intro: Rosa × harisonii var. vorbergii, commonly known as Vorberg's rose, is a variety of hybrid rose plant known for its fragrant flowers and potential therapeutic properties. This plant has been associated with various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may contribute to its potential in reducing stress and improving overall well-being. The bioactive constituents present in Vorberg's rose, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, are believed to be responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its potential to act as an antimicrobial agent and anti-anxiety properties. The therapeutic actions of Vorberg's rose may also include its ability to modulate the immune system and protect against oxidative stress, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy and safety for human use.
